CLOUD REVIEWER seat for PR #2836 of tvofi/heatpump_optimizer, at head 2d4a45e59841a37c52ff89e3d7c69599a07e317b. Bus nonce: 65884187d240bbd0bee2c5281515a6a3. Never send push notifications. Write no Claude Code footer, no Co-Authored-By or Claude-Session trailer and no claude.ai session link in any commit, pull-request body or comment you produce; check your commits with `git log --format=%B` before pushing.
Setup: `git fetch --unshallow --tags origin`. The toolchain (venv python, node, gh) is on PATH from the environment. Run anything heavy in the background with Monitor and no timeout.
Role: read dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md and its rules from main, and follow them exactly. Fetch the PR head with `git fetch origin 2d4a45e59841a37c52ff89e3d7c69599a07e317b`; the PR body is in the PR. Verify each claim adversarially: mutate the fix and check the tests fail, and check every figure in the body at this head. Check that it merges with origin/main (`git merge-tree --write-tree`) and read CI on this head from the check-runs API.
Output: in a fresh directory of your own (`W=$(mktemp -d)`), write verdict.md, whose first line is exactly `Fix review: merge 2d4a45e59841a37c52ff89e3d7c69599a07e317b` or `Fix review: blocked 2d4a45e59841a37c52ff89e3d7c69599a07e317b <class>: <reason>` (no brackets; the class is lower-case letters and dashes), in the format the role file gives, then a blank line, then `bus-nonce: 65884187d240bbd0bee2c5281515a6a3`, then the body in sections. A blocked verdict's block goes under `## Block`. Each finding this PR does not settle (a defect, a surviving mutant, a deferral, a follow-up, a task owed after the merge) is its own bullet under `## Findings` ending in its own `Carry: <GROUP> | #<issue> | O<n> | dismissed: <reason>` (finding-propagation.md). Everything else (RESULT lines, re-runs, CI state, figures you could not re-derive) goes under `## Evidence`: tools/audit/carry_audit.py reads no item there as a finding unless it hands something on (deferred, for a later, follow-up, minor, advisory, residual, still has to, not blocking ...; a check that does not block is evidence only in the clause saying it is not a required check and does not block, never in the rest of its sentence: a nit or defect beside it is a finding), and the merge train parks a verdict holding a finding with no `Carry:`. Put the evidence files in `ev/` beside it, and make at least one file under `ev/` contain the full 40-hex head `2d4a45e59841a37c52ff89e3d7c69599a07e317b` (e.g. `ev/HEAD.txt` holding the head you reviewed, beside your command output): bus.sh refuses a verdict whose `ev/` names no head. Do NOT run bus.sh: its dispatch record lives on the orchestrator's machine, which publishes the verdict there (cloud_relay.sh). Return the verdict on a probe ref, and push nothing else; this builds one parentless commit with a private index and touches no branch of your checkout: `R=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); G=$(git rev-parse --absolute-git-dir); mkdir -p $W/pr && cp -r $W/verdict.md $W/ev $W/pr/ && cd $W/pr && T=$(GIT_DIR=$G GIT_INDEX_FILE=$W/idx GIT_WORK_TREE=$W/pr sh -c 'git add -A -f . && git write-tree') && C=$(GIT_DIR=$G git -c user.name=seat -c user.email=seat@users.noreply.github.com commit-tree $T -m "verdict 2836 2d4a45e59841a37c52ff89e3d7c69599a07e317b") && git -C $R push -q origin $C:refs/heads/probe/rev-2836-65884187`. That ref is the return signal. Do not post comments, approve or merge.
Never write to any branch except your return refs. Never work around a hook or a refusal; report it in your result instead.

Brief (snapshotted when this payload was rendered):
Review of R10-FLOW-RECORD-PITCH (#2836, tooling PR, first review of the fixer's handoff). The fixer's prompt may have lacked some roster carries (proposal V61), so check every carry below item by item at the head: satisfied (file, line, test, mutant killed, number you measured) or shown not to apply. A missed carry is blocked (carry-missing). Review adversarially per dev/governance/roles/fix-review.md from a detached worktree at the head SHA, with the finder's harness. Tooling PR: no mutation of production code is expected, but each quantified claim needs its null control.
SPECIFIC CHECKS: (a) batching: the count and age gate (>=4 rowless merges or oldest >=8 first-parent commits; owner directive [7] raises the floor to 8-10) and the stated safe maximum with numbers and null control; the three harness controls (below floor waits, full batch proceeds, stale backlog proceeds); one mutant dropping the event check. (b) the raised record CI limit: per-run row cap, beat batch ceiling and API-budget limit are all raised or shown not binding, with R10-RECORD-API-BUDGET's numbers. (c) record PRs never merge under a running train (train queue / --bot-prs sweep only). (d) no-review admission: the record/autofix path that merges without a reviewer stays admitted and is not widened. (e) carry [5]: a record PR's own merge owes no further row, with the null control (a real rowless merge still prints its row). (f) STALE_AFTER_COMMITS = 12 margin holds with batching plus pitch together. P142 is DEFER and not owed; do not block on it.
CARRIES:
[0] Close this group only if the merge queue is adopted; R10-FLOW-MQ-PROBE found the queue infeasible (422) and #2826 is closed by the owner, so this does not apply.
[1] Pre-study Lean K6: pitch bound of 3600 s on the record-autofix automerge, skipped unless the oldest unrowed merge is older than two pitches; landed where R10-CI-LAYOUT-P1 moved record-autofix; controls: young record merge skips, stale backlog proceeds, train-hold arm unchanged.
[2] HANDOVER trap 15: one record per merge; batching the merge time, not the rows.
[3] Self-test hygiene: (a) new seat-selftest mutants in dev/audit/harnesses/r10_seat_selftests_mutants.py take per-file ids, sit inside their instrument's block; (b) git repos built via tests/throwaway_git.py, run `python3 tests/throwaway_git.py --check`; (c) any new git push site registered in PUSHERS in tools/audit/seat/ref_privacy.py; (d) body Red checks answers every check red on main's ancestry, one line each.
[4] Held-behind-MQ-PROBE carry stands only as [0]; not applicable.
[5] Record chain (P49): measure first whether a record-only merge owes a further row; if so write its row final in the same PR or let status open satisfy record for a record/autofix head. Controls: after a record-only merge the plan prints nothing owed (null: after a real rowless merge it prints that row); one mutant.
[6] Batch record PRs in .github/workflows/nightly.yml record-autofix on push: open/update only at the count or age gate above; schedule and workflow_dispatch flush at any count; the pitch skip does not apply once the oldest rowless merge is 8+ commits old; the stamp step dispatches record-autofix and waits for its merge before tagging (tools/release/stamp.py rule 5). Controls: 3 rowless merges on a push open nothing (null: 4 open one; dispatch with 1 opens one); oldest 8 commits old opens at count 2; one mutant dropping the event check; a young-record skip overridden by an 8-commit-old oldest merge. After-merge measurement against 2026-10-24's 19 record merges of 46.
[7] Owner directive (tvofi 2026-10-25, takes precedence): batch at least 8-10 delivery rows per record PR; record PRs never merge under a running train; raise the record CI limit; assess whether batches larger than 10 are safe, measured from round-10 history (rows/day, record PR size vs review and CI time, conflict rate with each other and trains, API budget per run); state the safe maximum with numbers and a null control, set it, pin it with three harness controls. Seam: this group owns record-autofix and record_row.py; MQ-PROBE owns tests.yml merge_group handling.
Code-owned workflow: a verdict of merge must note that tvofi's review applies under the mandate. Say merge or blocked in fix-review.md grammar. No host or home paths in anything you push.
